_comment: Copy to channels.json (git-ignored) and edit. ids: from `python -m tools.telegram_setup`; a channel keeps its id when renamed. title_regex: chats you join later whose title matches are followed too (the tipster's next tournament channel). settings: .env settings that differ for this channel's trades. auto_bookset_units is a safety net for a bookset message that never comes, so it sits above the tipster's usual booking: on the SS ledger (Sep-Oct 2026) +1 unit would have cut its +22.8 units to +0.1, +3 units to +18.3.

tipster.hint: Tennis trading. Entries: 'Back <player> <odds> odds <units> unit' (often a screenshot caption; the screenshot shows the live price). Exits: 'Bookset' / 'book pannuga' = close now; 'Loss cut 2.5 la' = close now. Nicknames: 'goat' / '🐐' / 'Karupan' = Novak Djokovic. 'Thanks ra bubi' and result posts are not instructions.

ss.hint: Cricket jackpot trading (tennis sometimes). Entries: '<odds> odds back <team>' or '<team> back <odds> odds', the stake usually in the NEXT message: 'Limit 1', 'Limit 1.5 use', 'Only one limit', 'Half limit'. In this channel 'Losscut' / 'Losscut now' means close the trade NOW (it may be in profit): close with loss_cut true. 'Bookset', 'Now bookset', 'Good profit means bookset' = close now. 'Bookset coming', 'Be active', 'Ready for bookset' = not yet. '<team> win or low odds coming', 'Wait for my entry', zone lists ('1 to 4 over X zone') and '<a> odds to <b> odds jackpot done' are not instructions. 'Taken back <team>' / 'Taken back <team> now' = an entry on that team. 'Open rate back 6.4 odds' = an entry at the opening price. 'Try small amount', 'Try 200 or 300' right after an entry = its stake. Results and price updates ('1.66 fav ban', 'Wi 1.26 fire', 'my side non cutting done', 'Loss 1.5 limit only', 'Small amount i try 4.4k done ✅' — 'done ✅' or a profit amount means a result) are not instructions. Team codes: rno, tus, lim, grb, eci, war, wp, kg, lio, nwd, dol, lmp, mls, hob, ads, vic, sa e (South Africa Emerging).

tennistv.hint: Tennis in-play tips in Hindi. Entry: '<PLAYER> Win Karo' with '<a> limit use kro <b> limit rhega <PLAYER> pr' = back PLAYER with a units, odds 1 + b/a (the screenshot shows the live price and the full name). 'HALF LIMIT EXTRA' = add. Close now: 'Cashout done x - x limit', 'Bookset lifeset', 'Cashout karlo'. Not a close: 'Cashout khudse kr lena' (cash out yourself), 'Entry kr lena sabhi log cashout khudse krna'. Worksheets ('PASS', 'X/Y'), member testimonials, paribook247 ads, abuse and 'paid group' posts are not instructions.
